text:
Leah: Heads up  corpcard declined when buying my rail ticket (Eurail app) so I paid with personal card. Then I took an Uber and used personal too. Receipts attached: rail_e_ticket.pdf (EUR 54.00), uber_receipt.jpg (EUR 18.50). Trip date 2026-08-14 AMS->Haarlem. @Ben FYI for approval.
Leah: Later the corpcard posted a combined charge to my company card: EUR 72.50 descriptor 'EU RAIL & TRANSIT' which looks like it charged the rail+uber after the fact. I don't want to double-reimburse if finance reconciles that.
Priya - Finance: Thanks Leah. Two parts: (1) get OOP reimbursement for now via Concur and (2) CardOps will investigate whether the corpcard posting covers the same tickets so we can reverse any duplicate. Please submit Concur with both receipts and add note: "corpcard declined at purchase; personal card used; reconcile if corpcard posts".
Leah: Submitted Concur ID `EXP-2026-0814-9981` and added the note. Split lines: rail EUR 54.00 TL_RAIL, uber EUR 18.50 TR_TAXI.
Ben - Manager: I approve the reimbursement. Confirming Leah will not collect twice if corpcard clears. Ben approves.
CardOpsBot: Created ticket CORP-CARD-11789 for payment processor trace. Please include merchant descriptor screenshot if available.
Priya - Finance: We'll mark the submission as manager-approved and queue for expedited payment. Important: do NOT issue final payment until CardOps confirms whether the corpcard charge is a post-authorized capture for the same transaction. If processor confirms corpcard covered it, we'll reject the OOP or request repayment.
Leah: I can attach the bank charge screen that shows the EUR 72.50 on the corpcard — uploaded as corpcard_post.png to the Concur note. It lists a transaction ID: TXN-5528893 and descriptor.
CardOpsBot: Noted. Added TXN-5528893 to internal trace. We'll check merchant acquirer mapping and capture vs pre-auth flow. ETA 48 hours.
Priya - Finance: Workflow for clarity: 1) We tentatively approve as OOP; 2) CardOps determines if corpcard equals same charge; 3a) If duplicate, finance will void the Concur reimbursement and create a reversing journal, asking you to cancel any disbursement or repay if already paid. 3b) If corpcard didnt post or was declined entirely, we pay OOP.
Leah: Thanks. One more Q: should I tag currency conversion or do you handle FX?
Priya - Finance: We convert at the CCFX rate on the transaction date. Put the original EUR amounts in Concur and we'll record USD conversion on processing. No action needed.
ExpenseBot: Expense EXP-2026-0814-9981 submitted by Leah at 2026-08-15 08:21 UTC. Status: awaiting card ops confirmation.
Ben - Manager: Thanks all. CardOps please loop back here when you have the trace so Priya can finalize.
CardOpsBot: CORP-CARD-11789 update: acquirer confirms capture posted for EUR 72.50 and maps to the rail merchant. They report this covers the rail portion only (EUR 54.00). The EUR 18.50 Uber still appears unpaid. Will follow up with processor to confirm mapping.
Priya - Finance: Good find. We'll reimburse Uber line (EUR 18.50) and hold the rail line pending final confirmation. Leah, we'll adjust Concur to only pay the Uber if possible and leave rail pending. Expect update in 24-48 hours.
Leah: Appreciate it. Leaving this thread as audit trail.
Priya - Finance: Final note: if processor later shows rail capture was for a different invoice, we'll reverse accordingly. We'll post final status here once done. :white_check_mark:
